title: Republic of Kazakhstan: Climate Adaptation Options and Opportunities in the Agriculture Sector
temporal_coverage: Observed climate and agricultural indicators to 2024; historical metering pilot and adaptation plans; future drought risks with unspecified warming scenarios.
methodology: Rapid literature review and interviews with selected agriculture producers and stakeholders.
limitations: National technical synthesis; some findings are report-era plans.

title: Water-Related Climate Hazards and Adaptation Measures in Kazakhstan: Data and Literature Analysis
organization: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH; EarthYield Advisories GbR
temporal_coverage: Historical hazard baseline and 2021 impacts; modeled drought, flood and heatwave probabilities through 2080 or later under SSP1-2.6, SSP2-4.5 and SSP5-8.5.
methodology: Literature review, expert exchange and grid-based hazard modeling under three SSP scenarios.
limitations: Hydrological drought and general water depletion were omitted for data gaps; some local findings are secondary citations.

title: The Impact of Climate Change on the Dynamics of Conflicts in the Transboundary River Basins of Kyrgyzstan, Kazakhstan and Tajikistan
temporal_coverage: Field research September-November 2021; includes historical 2012-2013 water disputes and reported 2021 conditions.

title: A New Growth Model for Building a Secure Middle Class: Kazakhstan Systematic Country Diagnostic
temporal_coverage: Systematic country diagnostic published 2018; climate-susceptibility mapping uses 2014 data.
methodology: Country diagnostic drawing on administrative, household-survey and sector evidence.
limitations: Historic diagnosis; cited climate-susceptibility map reflects 2014 conditions.

title: Climate Resilient Water Resources Development
temporal_coverage: Project duration 26 September 2025 to 31 December 2027; page reports ongoing implementation.
methodology: Official project page describes objectives, partners, duration and status.
limitations: Page describes intended activities, not evaluated outcomes.
